cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

specificity.evidence: A1 coffee substitute and B2 proper coffee establish an ordinary economy experiment.
